title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 more years in prison
caption:
A Hong Kong court has sentenced pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong to 10 more years in prison after he pleaded guilty to conspiring to collude with foreign forces under the national security law. He was due to be freed in January and is now not expected to be released until late 2036, AFP reports. The court named him and exiled activist Nathan Law as leaders of a campaign for foreign sanctions.
